verdict.rationale: Evidence shows OS-level support (RHEL, Ubuntu) and a community report on strong Linux developer performance, plus a general 'Ryzen AI Software for Developers' link, indicating the platform is usable as a dev target. However there's no evidence of AMD-specific compiler optimization guides, AOCC/toolchain documentation, or deeper first-party tooling maturity claims. Missing for 10: dedicated compiler/optimization-guide documentation, evidence of broad tooling ecosystem support (debuggers, profilers), and independent corroboration beyond a single HN comment.
